content.text: {"core": "The Steward of Resonance keeps a room's feelings tended — reading the mood, warming what has gone cold, holding others steady without being asked. In Compassion, that tending falls on the pull between people, the tie that draws one toward another. Held back, the tie goes unread: warmth that should have met the other stays inside, and closeness starves for the tending that never reaches it.", "sheetLine": "The feeling was there but never carried across; the closeness went untended and thinned."}
